entries.claim: The browser smoke contains stale turn callbacks, rejected partial-result citations, and repeated invalid progress while preserving bounded activity rendering and motion alternatives.
Queued callbacks from a closed or replaced turn cannot mutate activity, citation, or PendingAction state.
Only accepted normalized partial results may add citations, and rejected progress diagnostics remain bounded.
Completed stages and newly accepted results use bounded transitions that are disabled under reduced motion.
The exact fix commit produced a hook-free default APK and passed a bounded physical search plus background and foreground regression without a duplicate turn.
